findings.title: Release/SBOM artifacts are integrity-checked but unsigned; image/SBOM license gate not enforced
findings.recommendation: Sign sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256 (ed25519/GPG or GitHub attestations) and enforce a license allow/deny gate.
findings.detail: Sign sbom/SBOM_MANIFEST.sha256 (ed25519/GPG or GitHub attestations) and enforce a license allow/deny gate.
